<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

When a finite list covers all basis indices, pointwise admissible interpretation of the full derived closure is equivalent to one admissible interpretation satisfying the entire closure.

Canonical source: [Derivation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Derivation.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Existing Derives, a finite covering list and explicit admissible; pointwise coverage includes every derivable formula.

Admissible is not defined as basis truth; the reduction supplies neither actual admission nor root truth.

## Validation and boundaries

Separate interpretations for individual basis rows may have no common interpretation.

## Dependencies and related results

- **formal-reuse**: [derivation-soundness](derivation-soundness.md). The common-basis-to-common-closure direction uses soundness; local premises remain explicit.

**Output:** Basis and local assumptions guarantee the derived conclusion in the same interpretation.

**Input:** Extend a common basis witness to a common witness for the closure.

**Preserved conditions:** Finite coverage, admissibility and basis truth are not acquired by soundness. [JointInterpretation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/JointInterpretation.lean)
